sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the filter condition. Valid values:

- ResellerUid: The UID of the reseller.

- Name: The name of the reseller.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The values of the filter condition.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.
